description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipService class which provides an abstraction layer for managing employee membership data, including CRUD operations and search functionality, using underlying DAO methods.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manage employee memberships, interfacing with the DAO layer for data persistence and retrieval.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmployeeMembershipDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: setEmployeeMembershipDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeMembershipDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeMembership object via the DAO.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeMembership by employee number and ID.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Performs a search for employee memberships based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee memberships matching the search filter.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Deletes specified employee memberships for a given employee number.
